INSERT INTO ship_purchase_reservations (
                    shipyard_ship_id,
                    assignment_id,
                    fleet_id,
                    reservation_id,
                    state
                )
                SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
                    $1::bigint[],
                    $2::bigint[],
                    $3::integer[],
                    $4::bigint[],
                    $5::ship_purchase_reservation_state[]
                )
